components.name: Box

props.name: pad
props.desc: Inner padding — a rung/px, or a [block, inline] pair.

props.name: border
props.desc: true → --stroke, soft → --stroke-soft, or a color → 1px solid <color>.

props.name: radius
props.desc: Corner radius rung (--r-*) or raw px.

whenUse: The generic styled container — any div you'd otherwise write raw.
Applying token padding / bg / border / radius / shadow.
whenNot: A flex row or column — use Row / Stack.
Text — use Text.

components.name: Stack

props.name: gap
props.desc: Gap between children — a rung (xs…xl) or raw px.

props.name: wrap
props.desc: Allow children to wrap onto multiple lines.

props.name: pad
props.desc: Inner padding — a rung/px, or a [block, inline] pair.

props.name: inline
props.desc: Render as inline-flex instead of flex.

whenUse: Stacking children vertically with a consistent gap.
A form or a labelled list column.
whenNot: A horizontal cluster — use Row.
A 2-D layout with tracks — use Grid.

components.name: Row

props.name: gap
props.desc: Gap between children — a rung (xs…xl) or raw px.

props.name: wrap
props.desc: Allow children to wrap onto multiple lines.

props.name: pad
props.desc: Inner padding — a rung/px, or a [block, inline] pair.

props.name: inline
props.desc: Render as inline-flex instead of flex.

whenUse: Laying items in a horizontal line with a gap.
A header / toolbar cluster (pair with Spacer to push trailing items).
whenNot: A vertical column — use Stack.
Aligned tabular data — use Grid.

components.name: Spacer

props.name: size
props.desc: A rigid spacer of this size; omit for a greedy flex:1 filler.

whenUse: Pushing trailing items to the far edge of a Row (greedy flex:1).
A fixed rigid gap between two specific items.
whenNot: Even spacing between many children — use the parent's gap.
Inner padding — use pad.

components.name: Grid

props.name: cols
props.desc: Columns — a number → repeat(n, 1fr), or a gridTemplateColumns string.

props.name: rows
props.desc: Rows — a number → repeat(n, 1fr), or a gridTemplateRows string.

props.name: gap
props.desc: Gap between children — a rung (xs…xl) or raw px.

props.name: inline
props.desc: Render as inline-grid instead of grid.

whenUse: A 2-D layout with explicit column / row tracks.
A responsive card or tile grid.
whenNot: A single row or column — use Row / Stack.
One-off positioning — use Box.

components.name: SectionHeader

props.name: hint
props.desc: Dimmed inline sub-text after the title.

props.name: meta
props.desc: Right-aligned dim mono text (e.g. a count).

props.name: titleStyle
props.desc: Inline style for the title element.

whenUse: A titled section heading with an optional trailing control.
The head of a settings or card group.
whenNot: A page title — that's screen chrome.
A bare eyebrow label — use SectionLabel.

components.name: SectionLabel

props.name: size
props.desc: md (10px/.06em) or sm (9px/.08em, denser KPI tiles).

whenUse: A small uppercase eyebrow labelling a group.
A field-group or list-section caption.
whenNot: A full heading with actions — use SectionHeader.
Body copy — use Text.

components.name: Dialog

props.name: danger
props.desc: Red heading + border for a destructive confirm.

whenUse: A focused, blocking task (confirm or short form).
Content that must be dismissed before continuing.
whenNot: Non-blocking info — use a Banner / toast.
A large multi-step flow — use a page / stage.
components.srcText:
import { Dialog } from "@/shared/ui/overlay/Dialog";

<Dialog title={…} actions={…} onDismiss={…}>…</Dialog>

components.name: ModalScrim

props.name: onDismiss
props.desc: Escape / scrim-click dismiss; omit to make it non-dismissable.

props.name: align
props.desc: Center the card, or top-align it for tall scrolling modals.

whenUse: The dimmed, click-to-dismiss backdrop behind a modal surface.
Trapping focus under a Dialog.
whenNot: A non-modal overlay — use a positioned Box.
The whole modal — compose this inside a Dialog.

components.name: Text

props.name: size
props.desc: Font size — a rung (xxs…xl) or raw px. Omit to inherit.

props.name: tone
props.desc: Semantic color tone. Omit to inherit.

props.name: mono
props.desc: Apply the mono (JetBrains Mono) utility class.

props.name: weight
props.desc: Font weight — a number (500/600) or CSS keyword.

props.name: loading
props.desc: Render the text loading — an inline shimmer line the height of the text (#2302).

whenUse: Any text — sized by rung, semantically toned, mono or not.
Labels, values, and body copy.
whenNot: A raw string in a slot that already styles its text.
An interactive label — pair it with a control.

components.name: Button
whenUse: A single, discrete action the user can take.
Form submit / primary CTA (use variant="primary", one per view).
Inline row actions (use variant="ghost").
whenNot: Navigating between views — use a link.
Toggling a persistent on/off state — use Toggle.

components.name: IconButton

props.name: children
props.desc: The glyph; defaults to the close ✕.

whenUse: A compact glyph-only action (close, more, expand).
A dense toolbar where a text label won't fit.
whenNot: A labelled action — use Button.
A persistent on/off state — use Toggle.

components.name: Checkbox
whenUse: A single boolean in a form or list row.
Multi-select where each item is independently on/off.
whenNot: A prominent on/off switch — use Toggle.
Mutually-exclusive options — use SegmentedControl.

components.name: Toggle
whenUse: An immediate on/off switch (a setting that applies at once).
A prominent binary state.
whenNot: A form value submitted later — use Checkbox.
More than two states — use SegmentedControl.

components.name: SegmentedControl

props.name: options
props.desc: SegOption[] — { label, on, onClick, tone?, dot?, title? }.

whenUse: 2–4 mutually-exclusive options (mode / scope).
A multi-toggle where each option holds its own state.
whenNot: Many options (>5) — use a select.
A single on/off — use Toggle.

components.name: TextField

props.name: trailing
props.desc: Right-aligned control in the label row.

props.name: loading
props.desc: Render the field loading — keep the label, skeleton the input (#2302).

whenUse: Any single-line text input with a label.
Controlled form fields (value + onChange).
whenNot: Multi-line input — use a textarea.
A boolean — use Toggle / Checkbox.

components.name: SelectField
whenUse: Choosing one option from a longer fixed list (>4).
A labelled dropdown inside a form.
whenNot: 2–4 options — use SegmentedControl.
Free text — use TextField.

components.name: BackButton

props.name: aria-label
props.desc: Screen-reader label — required (the bare chevron has no text).

props.name: variant
props.desc: Boxed 30×30 chevron (icon) vs chevron + text label (text).

props.name: label
props.desc: Text-variant label after the chevron (ignored for icon).

props.name: size
props.desc: Chevron size in px (default 18 icon / 14 text).

whenUse: Returning to the previous view within a screen.
A detail → list back affordance.
whenNot: App-level navigation — use the Rail.
A generic action — use Button.

components.name: ColorSwatch

props.name: color
props.desc: Fill color — any CSS color incl. var()/color-mix().

whenUse: Picking or displaying a color / token value.
A keyed color in a legend or settings row.
whenNot: A live status color — use StatusDot.
A category label — use Chip.

components.name: ConfirmButton

props.name: armedLabel
props.desc: Label shown once armed (after the first click).

props.name: onConfirm
props.desc: Fired on the confirming second click.

props.name: size
props.desc: Control size — md (reset cards) or sm (inline row actions).

whenUse: A destructive action that needs an in-place two-step confirm.
Delete / reset where a Dialog is too heavy.
whenNot: A safe, single-step action — use Button.
A blocking decision with context — use Dialog.
components.srcText:
import { ConfirmButton } from "@/shared/ui/controls/ConfirmButton";

<ConfirmButton label={…} armedLabel={…} onConfirm={…} />

components.name: Card

props.name: right
props.desc: Right-aligned control in the head row.

props.name: header
props.desc: A fully-custom header node (wins over title).

props.name: loading
props.desc: Render the card loading — a skeleton body the shape of its content (#2302).

whenUse: Group related content in a framed surface.
A selectable item in a list (interactive).
whenNot: Full-bleed page sections — cards imply containment.
A modal — use Dialog.

components.name: Chip

props.name: loading
props.desc: Render the chip loading — a shimmer pill (#2302).

whenUse: A short, non-interactive status or category label.
Dynamic colors (GitHub labels) via the color prop.
whenNot: A clickable filter — use SegmentedControl.
Long text — chips are single-line.

components.name: StatTile
whenUse: A single key / value metric with an optional sub-line.
A compact KPI in a row of stats.
whenNot: A trend over time — use a chart.
A large headline number — use Text.

components.name: FillBar

props.name: loading
props.desc: Render the bar loading — an indeterminate shimmer track (#2302).

whenUse: A horizontal progress / proportion bar (0–1 fraction).
A budget or usage meter.
whenNot: A precise value — pair it with a label.
A time series — use a chart.

components.name: Code

props.name: wrap
props.desc: Soft-wrap long lines vs a horizontal scroll.

props.name: loading
props.desc: Render the block loading — shimmer lines inside the frame (#2302).

whenUse: A read-only, scrollable monospace code / prompt block.
Showing a command, config, or source snippet.
whenNot: Editable code — use an editor.
Inline mono text — use Text mono.

components.name: Avatar

props.name: login
props.desc: GitHub login — its initial on a login-hashed color.

props.name: palette
props.desc: Use the discrete assignee-stack palette instead of the continuous login hue.

props.name: bordered
props.desc: 1.5px canvas ring so overlapping avatars read as separate disks.

props.name: ml
props.desc: Left margin — negative for overlapping assignee stacks.

props.name: fontScale
props.desc: Initial font size as a fraction of size.

whenUse: A person / agent identity glyph or initials.
A compact author or owner marker in a row.
whenNot: A live status indicator — use StatusDot.
A category tag — use Chip.

components.name: IconBox
whenUse: A framed icon tile — a leading glyph on a surface.
The icon slot of a card or empty state.
whenNot: A clickable icon — use IconButton.
A bare inline glyph — use Text.

components.name: CardListRow

props.name: lead
props.desc: 18px lead column — a status dot, icon, or avatar.

props.name: badge
props.desc: A pill next to the title (left of the spacer).

props.name: titleAside
props.desc: Right-aligned element on the title line.

props.name: body
props.desc: Full-width rich content below the header line.

props.name: variant
props.desc: Bordered card vs borderless top-separated group row.

props.name: accent
props.desc: Left-rail accent color shown when selected.

whenUse: A selectable row in a card-style list.
A master-list item with a leading glyph + trailing meta.
whenNot: A dense table row — use DataTableRow.
A standalone card — use Card.

components.name: DataTableRow

props.name: template
props.desc: grid-template-columns — share with the DataTableHeader so cells align under labels.

props.name: children
props.desc: Cell content, one node per column.

props.name: index
props.desc: Row index — odd rows get a zebra-stripe when provided.

whenUse: A row in a dense, column-aligned data table.
Tabular records with fixed columns.
whenNot: A card-style list — use CardListRow.
A single metric — use StatTile.

components.name: StatCard

props.name: loading
props.desc: Render value + sub as shimmer placeholders while the metric loads (#2234).

whenUse: A framed metric card — label, value, optional trend.
A dashboard KPI tile.
whenNot: A bare inline stat — use StatTile.
A full chart — use a chart primitive.

components.name: LineArea

props.name: series
props.desc: LineSeries[] — { name, color, data:number[], width?, dash?, dots?, fill?, dotR? }.

props.name: labels
props.desc: X-axis labels (string[]), one per data point.

props.name: yMax
props.desc: Fixed y-axis max (else derived from the data).

props.name: area
props.desc: Fill the area under each series.

props.name: fmtY
props.desc: Format a y value for the axis + tooltip.

whenUse: A trend over continuous time, with the area emphasizing magnitude.
A single series where the shape matters more than exact points.
whenNot: Comparing discrete categories — use Bars.
A tiny inline glyph — use Spark.

components.name: Bars

props.name: stacked
props.desc: Stack the groups instead of clustering them.

props.name: fmtY
props.desc: Format a y value for the axis + tooltip.

whenUse: Comparing a value across a small set of categories.
A discrete, labelled distribution (per-day, per-stream counts).
whenNot: A trend over continuous time — use LineArea/Spark.
Parts of a whole — use Donut.

components.name: Donut
whenUse: Parts of a whole at a glance (a few large segments).
A single proportion with a centered value.
whenNot: Many small slices (hard to compare) — use HBars.
A trend — use LineArea.

components.name: HBars

props.name: rows
props.desc: HBarRow[] — { label, value, color?, strong?, icon?, tag? }.

props.name: max
props.desc: Fixed bar max (else the largest row value).

whenUse: Ranking categories with long labels (labels read left-to-right).
A leaderboard or top-N breakdown.
whenNot: Many categories that scroll — use a table.
A time series — use LineArea.

components.name: Swimlane

props.name: events
props.desc: SwimEvent[] — { lane, t0, t1?, color, label, r? } (t in 0–1).

props.name: marks
props.desc: SwimMark[] — { t, label } vertical time markers.

whenUse: Per-lane activity across a shared horizontal axis (streams over time).
A timeline where each row is an independent track.
whenNot: A single aggregate series — use LineArea.
Category totals — use Bars.

components.name: Spark

props.name: dot
props.desc: Show a dot at the last point.

whenUse: A tiny inline trend beside a metric (no axes).
A dense row/tile where a full chart won't fit.
whenNot: A chart the user must read precisely — use LineArea with axes.
Category comparison — use Bars.

components.name: Legend
whenUse: Keying a chart's colors to their meaning.
A compact color↔label index beside a graph.
whenNot: A clickable filter — use SegmentedControl / Chips.
Status on one item — use StatusDot.

components.name: StackedDayBars

props.name: upperLabel
props.desc: Legend label for the upper (top) series.

props.name: lowerLabel
props.desc: Legend label for the lower (baseline) series.

whenUse: A per-day total split into composition segments (a stacked column per day).
Daily volume with a status/category breakdown.
whenNot: A single continuous line — use LineArea.
One category only — use Bars.
components.srcText:
import { StackedDayBars } from "@/shared/ui/charts/Charts";

<StackedDayBars data={…} title={…} subtitle={…} upperLabel={…} lowerLabel={…} />

components.name: Banner

props.name: onDismiss
props.desc: Show a dismiss ✕ and call this.

whenUse: An inline or full-width status message with a tone.
A dismissible notice above content.
whenNot: A blocking decision — use Dialog.
A short inline error — use InlineError.

components.name: InlineError

props.name: pad
props.desc: Inner padding — a rung/px or a [block, inline] pair.

props.name: radius
props.desc: Corner radius rung (--r-*) or raw px.

props.name: borderFade
props.desc: Border tint — transparency % of --danger in the 1px border (some sites use 60).

whenUse: A short static error string on a danger wash.
A field- or section-level failure note.
whenNot: A dismissible page notice — use Banner.
A blocking error — use Dialog.

components.name: EmptyState
whenUse: A list / view with nothing in it yet.
An onboarding / connect prompt with a CTA.
whenNot: A transient loading state — use a skeleton.
An error — use InlineError / Banner.

components.name: StatusDot
whenUse: A tiny live activity indicator beside a label.
Session / build state in a dense row.
whenNot: Conveying state by color alone — pair with text.
A large status graphic — use a Banner.

components.name: Skeleton

props.name: w
props.desc: Width — a px number or a CSS length string.

props.name: h
props.desc: Height — a px number or a CSS length string.

whenUse: A shape-matched loading placeholder while content loads.
The loading state a content component renders for itself (#2302).
whenNot: An empty (no-data) state — use EmptyState.
An error — use InlineError / Banner.

components.name: MasterDetail

props.name: rail
props.desc: The master column — the list/nav rail.

props.name: detail
props.desc: The detail column — the selected item's editor/view.

props.name: toolbar
props.desc: Optional full-width toolbar/header above both columns.

props.name: railWidth
props.desc: Fixed rail width in px (the starting width when resizable).

props.name: railPad
props.desc: Rail inner padding — a rung/px or [block, inline] pair.

props.name: detailPad
props.desc: Detail inner padding — a rung/px or [block, inline] pair.

props.name: resizable
props.desc: Opt into a drag-resizable rail (a .resize-x splitter), bounded by railMin/railMax.

whenUse: A list/nav rail beside a detail view (Personas · Skills · MCP · GitHub · Security · Settings).
Any master→detail page where selecting a rail row drives the detail column.
whenNot: A free pan/zoom graph — use GraphCanvas.
A two-pane split with no fixed list rail — use SplitView.

components.name: SplitView

props.name: primary
props.desc: The flexing pane — fills the remaining space (terminal, editor, main content).

props.name: secondary
props.desc: The fixed-size, drag-resizable trailing pane (inspector, sidebar, detail).

props.name: toolbar
props.desc: Optional full-width toolbar/header above the split.

props.name: orientation
props.desc: horizontal → side by side; vertical → primary above secondary.

props.name: resizable
props.desc: Draw the drag splitter (opt out for a fixed secondary), bounded by secondaryMin/secondaryMax.

props.name: secondarySize
props.desc: Secondary size in px (width when horizontal, height when vertical) — the starting size.

props.name: divider
props.desc: Draw the 1px divider border between the two panes.

whenUse: A resizable two-pane split (the planner session's terminal + inspector).
A main content area beside a fixed, draggable side panel.
whenNot: A fixed-width list rail + detail — use MasterDetail.
A grid of many equal panes — use PaneGrid.

components.name: GraphCanvas

props.name: vp
props.desc: The viewport created by the page's useGraphViewport().

props.name: world
props.desc: World (design-space) size { w, h } — drives the world layer's box.

props.name: toolbar
props.desc: Full toolbar content (search + palette + <ZoomControls vp={vp}/> + fit).

props.name: children
props.desc: World-layer content: grid, SVG edges, node cards — positioned in world coords.

props.name: inspector
props.desc: Optional inspector column on the right (feature-styled full node).

props.name: overlays
props.desc: Fixed overlays drawn over the canvas but NOT transformed (hints, legends).

props.name: grid
props.desc: Dotted graph-paper backdrop — an infinite grid on the viewport that tracks zoom + pan.

props.name: gridSize
props.desc: Grid tile size in world px (scaled by zoom on screen).

props.name: railResizable
props.desc: Make the left rail drag-resizable (a .resize-x splitter).

props.name: inspectorResizable
props.desc: Make the right inspector drag-resizable (splitter on its left edge).

props.name: onBackgroundClick
props.desc: Fires on a genuine click on the empty canvas backdrop (not a pan-drag end, not a node press).

whenUse: A pan/zoom graph workspace (Streams graph · Org designer · Glance).
Any node/edge canvas needing viewport wiring + an optional rail/inspector.
whenNot: A static list or form — use MasterDetail.
A CSS grid of equal panes — use PaneGrid.

components.name: PaneGrid

props.name: children
props.desc: The pane cells — N children laid across the grid tracks (cols × rows).

props.name: cols
props.desc: Column track count → repeat(cols, 1fr). Clamped to ≥ 1.

props.name: rows
props.desc: Row track count → repeat(rows, 1fr). Clamped to ≥ 1.

props.name: hidden
props.desc: Render the grid display:none but keep it MOUNTED (children stay alive — the console cross-tab mount).

whenUse: A CSS grid of N equal panes (the Console tab grid).
A dashboard of equally-weighted tiles kept alive across tab switches (hidden).
whenNot: A single list+detail split — use MasterDetail.
A pan/zoom graph — use GraphCanvas.
